entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return a helmet I bought. This is taking forever.
I can certainly look into that for you. May I have your order number, please?
It's VF8675309. Look, it's simple. The color is completely wrong. It looked different on your website, and I want my money back.

Okay, I have your order pulled up. I see the Aero Race Helmet, delivered on October 21st. That was 42 days ago. To start the process, could you tell me a bit more? Is it a technical fault with the helmet or a preference regarding the color?

What does it matter? It's the wrong color! I'm not wearing it. This is a safety issue! A helmet does no good if I refuse to wear it because the color is hideous. The box is still unopened, for crying out loud! Are you going to help me or are you going to waste my time with dumb questions?
Sir, I understand your frustration. The questions are just a standard part of the process. Please give me one moment to review the return eligibility for this item.

This is unbelievable. I want to talk to your manager right now. I'm going to leave a review about this on every cycling forum on the internet. 'VeloFit refuses to return an unopened helmet'. How does that sound?
That won't be necessary, sir. I've just checked our policy, and you're well within the 90-day return window for the helmet. I can approve this return for you right now.
Oh. So you can do it? It's not a problem?

Not at all. Since the box is unopened, it's a very straightforward process. I am generating a prepaid return label and I've just sent it to the email address on file. Just print it, attach it to the box, and drop it off at any shipping center. You'll see a full refund to your original payment method 3-5 business days after we receive it.
Okay. Good. That's all I needed. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
